|gr1= Math

|descr= Returns square root of x.

|s1= [[sqrt]] x

|p1= x: [[Number]]

|r1= [[Number]]

|x1= <sqf>private _squareRoot = sqrt 9;  // returns 3</sqf>

<dl class="command_description">

<dt><dt>
<dd class="notedate">Posted on 18:05, 24 August 2014 (EST)</dd>
<dt class="note">[[User:Benargee|Benargee]]</dt>
<dd class="note">
Alternatively use "x^0.5" or "x^(1/2)".
<sqf>
_sq = 9^0.5;	// result is 3
_sq = 9^(1/2);	// result is 3
</sqf>
You can use this method to get any root.
Cubed root = x^(1/3) or x^0.333[repeating].
Root 4 = x^(1/4) or x^0.25.
</dd>
